minutes.headline: Assessors approved the final assessing-services RFP and the principal Assessor job description, sent on to the Personnel Board.
minutes.summary: The remote Board of Assessors meeting reviewed edits to the property tax assessment services request for proposals and approved the changes by roll call. It then went through the draft principal Assessor job description line by line, including reporting lines, duties, education and experience, and a suggested pay grade, and approved the changes. The draft was to be finalised and taken to the Personnel Board that night.

votes.outcome: passed (roll call: Swayze, Franco and the chair aye as heard)

votes.motion: Approve the changes to the principal Assessor job description
votes.outcome: passed (ayes heard from the chair, Franco and others; full count not clear)

budget_items.topic: Pay grade for the principal Assessor position
budget_items.what_was_said: The suggested grade was said to match comparable finance and technology director positions, based on level of responsibility and comparison with other towns. Members agreed with it.

budget_items.topic: Staff the principal Assessor would supervise
budget_items.what_was_said: The description would add a part-time administrative assessing assistant and possibly a senior tax work-off worker, depending on budget and space.

decisions.decision: A post of the RFP on the MAA business services page was confirmed possible; the principal Assessor job could later go on the MAA job postings.
RFP scope items 19 and 21 would both stay, with 19 reworded to say it includes site inspections.
The evaluation reference would change to the five-year certification process.
The senior work-off program participation line would be removed from the job description.
A separate item on communicating changes with other departments would be added to the job description.
The court testimony wording was changed to say the Assessor may testify representing the municipality to defend values, not as an appraiser.
The RFP wording on meeting with the board once a month or on request would be copied into the job description.
The final job description draft would go to the Personnel Board that night.

what_happened.line: The Board of Assessors approved the changes to the property tax assessment services request for proposals by roll call.
The board approved the changes to the draft principal Assessor job description after a line-by-line review; the full vote count was not clear in the captions.
The job description's pay grade was said to match comparable finance and technology director positions, and members agreed with it.
The description would add a part-time administrative assessing assistant and possibly a senior tax work-off worker as staff the Assessor supervises, depending on budget and space.
The final job description draft was to go to the Personnel Board that night.

why_it_matters: The RFP and job description set how the town's property assessing work is bought or staffed, which feeds the valuations behind each resident's property tax bill.
The pay grade and added support staff for the principal Assessor position are a cost that falls on the town budget, mostly taxes, once the Personnel Board and later budget votes act.
watch_next: The Personnel Board's review of the principal Assessor job description and pay grade, due the night of the meeting.
Posting of the RFP on the MAA business services page and of the principal Assessor job on the MAA job postings.
